verses: Ziyadti ki chahat ney tumhen ghafil kerdiya
Yahan tak kay tum qabastan jaa phonchay
Hergiz nahi tum unqareeb maloom ker lo gay
Hergiz nahi phir tumhen jald ilm ho jaye ga
Hergiz nahi agar tum yaqeeni tor per jaan lo
To be-shak tum jahannum dekh lo gay
Aur tum ussay yaqeen ki aankh say dekh lo gay
Phir uss din tum say zaroor bil-zaroor nematon ka sawal hoga
